summary: The Gas Can Freedom Act of 2025 repeals the Portable Fuel Container Safety Act of 2020 and the Children’s Gasoline Burn Prevention Act, nullifies all related CPSC regulations, and bars the agency from requiring flame mitigation devices or child-resistant features on portable fuel containers.
